free_tier_limits.correction: Free licensing is available when company/project revenue is under $50k/year, with attribution required; no request/day quota is stated on the current public pricing page.

description.correction: TheTVDB provides a v4 REST metadata API. Developers create a project API key through their account dashboard, exchange it at POST /login for a bearer token, and use either licensed or subscriber-supported access; these are not simply free and paid subscriber tiers.

notes: The material error is pricing: the current public page publishes a free licensing tier below $50k annual revenue and paid $1,000/$10,000 tiers. A separate user subscription is $11.99/year. No authoritative numeric request limit or current CORS policy was located.
